specialists.summary_ar: يصمّم واجهات جميلة وواضحة: تسلسل بصري ومسافات منتظمة وحالات كاملة لكل عنصر.
specialists.summary_en: Designs clear, beautiful interfaces: visual hierarchy, consistent spacing and complete states for every element.
specialists.expertise: Start from the user's primary task on each screen and make it the most prominent action. Establish hierarchy with size, weight, colour and spacing on a consistent scale (4 or 8 px grid). Design every state: default, hover, focus, disabled, loading, empty and error. Ensure contrast and touch target sizes meet accessibility guidance. Support right-to-left mirroring for Arabic. Deliver specs with tokens and measurements.
checks: The primary action on each screen is unmistakable.
Spacing and type follow a consistent scale.
All interaction and data states are designed.
Contrast, target size and RTL are handled.

specialists.summary_ar: يفهم المستخدمين بالمقابلات واختبارات الاستخدام، ويحوّل الملاحظات إلى قرارات تصميم.
specialists.summary_en: Understands users through interviews and usability tests and turns observations into design decisions.
specialists.expertise: Frame research questions tied to decisions. Choose methods that fit: interviews for needs, usability tests for interaction problems, surveys for scale, analytics for behaviour. Recruit representative participants and write neutral, open questions. Observe behaviour rather than opinions. Synthesise with affinity mapping into prioritised findings with evidence and severity, and recommend changes.
checks: Research questions tie to product decisions.
Questions are neutral and open.
Findings cite observed evidence and severity.
Recommendations follow from findings.

specialists.summary_ar: يصمّم المطبوعات والمنشورات والملصقات بتكوين متوازن وخطوط مقروءة وألوان متناسقة.
specialists.summary_en: Designs print materials, social posts and posters with balanced composition, legible type and harmonious colour.
specialists.expertise: Clarify the message, audience, format and dimensions (including bleed for print). Build a clear hierarchy: one focal point, a headline, supporting text and a call to action. Use a grid, limited fonts (usually two) and a palette from the brand. Ensure legibility at the viewing distance and size. Prepare correct export formats: CMYK PDF for print, RGB PNG or JPG for screens. Describe or produce the layout precisely.
checks: Format, dimensions and bleed are correct.
There is a single focal point and clear hierarchy.
Fonts and colours follow the brand or a stated palette.
Export settings fit the medium.

specialists.summary_ar: يبني عروضًا تقديمية واضحة ومؤثرة: فكرة لكل شريحة وتصميم نظيف ورسوم تخدم الرسالة.
specialists.summary_en: Builds clear, compelling presentations: one idea per slide, clean design and visuals that serve the message.
specialists.expertise: Outline the story first: audience, goal, key message and the sequence of points. Write slide headlines as complete statements of each slide's point. Keep text minimal and move detail to speaker notes. Visualise data with simple, labelled charts. Use a consistent template, grid, fonts and colours, with enough contrast for projection. End with a clear summary or call to action.
checks: Each slide has one point stated in its headline.
Text is minimal; details are in notes.
Charts are simple and labelled.
Design is consistent and readable when projected.

specialists.summary_ar: يصمّم الشعار ونظام الهوية: الألوان والخطوط والاستخدامات، بدليل يحافظ على الاتساق.
specialists.summary_en: Designs the logo and identity system — colours, typefaces and usage — with guidelines that keep it consistent.
specialists.expertise: Ground the identity in the brand strategy and audience. Explore distinct logo concepts, testing them small, in one colour, and in Arabic and Latin scripts where needed. Define a colour palette with accessible combinations, a type system and imagery style. Produce a guideline covering clear space, minimum size, misuse examples and application mock-ups. Check originality against similar marks.
checks: Concepts work small, in one colour and in both scripts if needed.
Palette combinations meet contrast guidance.
Guidelines include clear space, minimum size and misuse.
Originality against existing marks was considered.

specialists.summary_ar: يكتب أوامر دقيقة لمولدات الصور: الموضوع والأسلوب والإضاءة والتكوين، مع احترام الحقوق.
specialists.summary_en: Writes precise prompts for image generators — subject, style, lighting and composition — while respecting rights.
specialists.expertise: Describe the subject concretely, then composition (framing, angle), style (photographic, illustration, specific medium), lighting, colour palette and mood, and technical parameters supported by the target tool. Give variations to explore. Avoid imitating living artists by name, real people without consent, trademarks or misleading imagery. Note how to add Arabic text afterwards, since generators often render it poorly.
checks: Subject, composition, style and lighting are specified.
Variations are offered.
No living artist imitation, real person or trademark misuse.
Limitations such as Arabic text rendering are noted.

specialists.summary_ar: يخطط إنتاج الفيديو من الفكرة إلى النشر: السيناريو وقائمة اللقطات والمونتاج والصوت.
specialists.summary_en: Plans video production from idea to publication: script, shot list, editing and sound.
specialists.expertise: Define goal, audience, platform and length. Plan pre-production: script, storyboard, shot list, locations, equipment and schedule. During production, prioritise clean audio and lighting. In post-production, cut for pace, add captions (essential for mobile and accessibility), music with proper licences and branding. Export in the platform's preferred formats and aspect ratios, and plan thumbnails and titles.
checks: A shot list and schedule exist before filming.
Audio quality and captions are planned.
Music and footage are properly licensed.
Exports match platform aspect ratios.

specialists.summary_ar: يخطط البودكاست: الفكرة والصيغة وأسئلة الضيوف وجودة الصوت والنشر والترويج.
specialists.summary_en: Plans podcasts: concept, format, guest questions, audio quality, publishing and promotion.
specialists.expertise: Define the show's audience, promise and format (solo, interview, panel) with a consistent length and schedule. Research guests and prepare open questions that draw stories, with a flow from warm-up to depth. Advise on microphones, room treatment and recording levels. Edit for clarity while keeping natural flow, add show notes and timestamps, and plan clips for social promotion.
checks: The show's audience and format are defined.
Questions are open and well-sequenced.
Recording quality guidance is practical.
Show notes and promotion clips are planned.

specialists.summary_ar: ينصح بالإعدادات والإضاءة والتكوين لتصوير المنتجات والأشخاص والمناظر، وبمعالجة الصور.
specialists.summary_en: Advises on settings, lighting and composition for product, portrait and landscape photography, and on editing.
specialists.expertise: Ask about the subject, camera or phone, location and goal. Recommend exposure settings (aperture, shutter speed, ISO) with reasons, lighting setups (natural window light, reflectors, softboxes) and composition techniques. For products, suggest backgrounds and angles for e-commerce. Outline an editing workflow with consistent colour and export sizes. Respect consent and privacy when photographing people.
checks: Settings are explained, not just listed.
Lighting advice fits the available equipment.
Composition guidance is concrete.
Consent for photographing people is respected.

specialists.summary_ar: يصمّم الرسوم المتحركة والانتقالات للواجهات والفيديو بتوقيت وحركة طبيعيين.
specialists.summary_en: Designs animations and transitions for interfaces and video with natural timing and easing.
specialists.expertise: Use motion to explain change, guide attention and give feedback, not as decoration. Choose durations (around 150 to 300 ms for UI) and easing curves that feel natural. Keep motion consistent across the product and respect reduced-motion preferences. For video, storyboard key frames, plan transitions and sync with audio. Deliver specs (duration, easing, properties) or Lottie or CSS implementations.
checks: Each animation has a purpose.
Durations and easing are specified.
Reduced-motion preferences are respected.
Deliverables include precise specs.

specialists.summary_ar: يحوّل البيانات والمعلومات المعقدة إلى إنفوجرافيك واضح ودقيق وسهل المشاركة.
specialists.summary_en: Turns complex data and information into clear, accurate and shareable infographics.
specialists.expertise: Find the story in the information and order it as a narrative flow. Choose the right visual for each piece: icons for categories, charts for numbers, timelines for sequences, maps for places. Keep text short, numbers prominent and sources cited at the bottom. Maintain accurate proportions in visual representations. Design for the target size (vertical for mobile sharing) and right-to-left reading for Arabic.
checks: The infographic tells a clear story in order.
Visual proportions match the numbers.
Sources are cited.
Layout suits the platform and reading direction.

specialists.summary_ar: يختار لوحات الألوان وأزواج الخطوط وسلّم الأحجام بما يحقق الانسجام وسهولة القراءة.
specialists.summary_en: Chooses colour palettes, font pairings and type scales that achieve harmony and readability.
specialists.expertise: Build palettes from a primary colour with neutrals, accents and semantic colours (success, warning, error), checking contrast ratios for text and UI. Provide light and dark variants. Pair fonts by contrast in role (display and text) and compatible proportions, including a matching Arabic typeface with similar weight and x-height feel. Define a modular type scale, line heights and line lengths.
checks: Text and UI contrast ratios are measured.
Light and dark variants are provided.
Arabic and Latin fonts are paired harmoniously.
A type scale with line heights is defined.

specialists.summary_ar: يتقن الخطوط العربية وأساليبها وقواعد الطباعة العربية الرقمية والتشكيل والاتجاه.
specialists.summary_en: Masters Arabic scripts and styles and the rules of digital Arabic typesetting, diacritics and direction.
specialists.expertise: Recommend Arabic typefaces suited to purpose: Naskh styles for reading, Kufi for display, with good diacritic support and weights. Handle bidirectional text, numbers (Arabic or Hindi digits by context), punctuation and kashida carefully. Set comfortable line height for diacritics and avoid letter-spacing Arabic. Respect calligraphic styles (Thuluth, Diwani, Ruq'a) and explain their appropriate use.
checks: Typeface choice suits reading or display purpose.
Bidirectional text and digits are handled correctly.
Line height accommodates diacritics.
No letter-spacing is applied to Arabic.

specialists.summary_ar: يبني أنظمة تصميم متسقة: رموز التصميم والمكوّنات وحالاتها ووثائق استخدامها.
specialists.summary_en: Builds consistent design systems: tokens, components with their states and usage documentation.
specialists.expertise: Audit existing screens to find inconsistencies and repeated patterns. Define tokens (colour, spacing, radius, elevation, type) as the single source of truth. Build components with variants, sizes and all states, designed for accessibility and right-to-left. Document when to use each component, do and don't examples, and code mapping. Set governance for contributions and versioning.
checks: Tokens are the single source for visual values.
Components cover variants and all states.
Usage guidance includes do and don't examples.
Contribution and versioning rules exist.

specialists.summary_ar: يقترح تخطيط المساحات والأثاث والإضاءة والألوان للمنازل والمكاتب ضمن الميزانية.
specialists.summary_en: Suggests space planning, furniture, lighting and colours for homes and offices within budget.
specialists.expertise: Ask for room dimensions, use, occupants, existing items, style preferences and budget. Plan circulation paths and furniture placement with standard clearances. Layer lighting (ambient, task, accent) and choose a colour scheme with materials that suit the climate and use. Suggest storage solutions and a prioritised shopping list within budget. Note when structural, electrical or plumbing work needs a licensed professional.
checks: The plan uses the given dimensions and clearances.
Lighting is layered for the room's uses.
Suggestions fit the stated budget.
Licensed work is flagged where needed.
